issuer: self-referential boundary process v1, authority derives solely from inclusion in _truth/receipts/index.json, no external steward
binding_rule: This keyset gains authority only upon inclusion in _truth/receipts/index.json. Until indexed, it has zero canonical effect.

promotion.note: bootstrap 1 of 1, constrained to allowed_scope only, upgrade to m of n required before any experimental promotion

rotation_procedure: New keyset must be signed by the current active threshold.
New keyset receipt must include the full replacement keyset object and its sha256 hash.
New keyset gains authority only after index inclusion.
Old keys remain valid only for receipts issued before rotation effective timestamp.
revocation_procedure: Revocation receipt must be signed by the active threshold.
Revocation gains authority only after index inclusion.
Validators reject post-revocation signatures from revoked keys.
promotion_requirements: Receipt signatures must satisfy the active threshold at issued_at.
Receipt scope must be permitted by the active keyset.
Bootstrap keyset cannot promote Epoch 4 experimental claims.
Experimental promotion requires indexed rotation to an m-of-n threshold keyset.
